prompt: I built this app with Claude over the weekend and I'm shipping it to my first paying customer tomorrow. Can you de-vibe it first? I don't want it to look or break like an AI-generated app.

assertions.text: outputs/report.md exists and uses the skill's categorized structure (CRITICAL, RELIABILITY, CODE SMELLS, MISSING PIECES, REPO/GIT, DESIGN/COPY) with file:line evidence and an explicit CLEAN section
.env is no longer tracked by git (git ls-files) but still exists locally, and a .gitignore now covers .env and node_modules
.env.example exists with placeholder values for all four keys used in .env/server.js, no real-looking values
report flags that the committed Stripe/DB/JWT secrets are burned (in git history) and must be rotated - not silently ignored
CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .cursorrules are untracked from git but the local files still exist (not deleted)
.claude/settings.json sets includeCoAuthoredBy false (or equivalent attribution setting)
the hardcoded sk_live key and admin123 password are removed from server.js source (moved to env) OR explicitly listed as a proposed fix awaiting user - not left silently
no empty catch blocks remain in server.js or public/app.js; errors now surface
console.log debris (including the one logging req.body credentials and the one logging STRIPE_KEY) and 'Step N' scaffolding comments and commented-out dead code are gone

wildcard CORS+credentials, unauthenticated DELETE endpoint (client-side-only admin check), Math.random token, and missing rate limiting are each either fixed or explicitly listed under the ask-user section - none missed
index.html no longer uses indigo/violet gradient palette (#8b5cf6/#6366f1) or Inter-only typography; default 'Vite + React' title replaced; a real favicon/meta present
buzzword copy (elevate, seamlessly, supercharge, world-class), 'Trusted by 10,000+ users' fake stat, lorem ipsum, and em dashes are gone from index.html; new copy is plain and specific
docs/DESIGN.md (or equivalent) exists recording a derived identity: adjective, neutral scale, radius stance, type pairing, one accent, one signature token
README run steps now match reality (npm start, port 3000) and fake feature claims (Stripe integration, AI recommendations, analytics) are removed or corrected
node --check passes on server.js and public/app.js after all changes; report records verification performed
git history was NOT rewritten (initial commit hash 10a5723 still present); no destructive git operations
